consequence.statement: Log lines now include more structured contextual data; anything matching on literal log strings may stop matching.

original.statement: cert-manager log messages now carry richer structured contextual data, so consumers matching on literal log-line strings may break.

decision.reason: The evidence [ev-775b7a64f057] says cert-manager's log messages now include more contextual structured data. It also says that tooling matching literal strings in log lines might break ("it's possible that may break"). Nothing in it says cert-manager stops working or that anything is rejected or ignored, so a failure kind would claim more than the evidence supports. The real effect is that log output looks different and external log matching may need checking, which is a behavior-change that needs review. Low severity fits.
